(a) The apPlicant for a type certificate shall submit to the Administrator such descriptive data, test reports, and computations as are necessary to demonstrate that the airplane complies with the requirements of this part.
(b) The descriptive data required in paragraph (a) of this section shall be known as the type design and shall consist of such drawings and specifications as are necessary to disclose the configuration of the airplane and all the design features covered in the requirements of this part, such information on dimensions, materials, and processes as is necessary to define the structura! strength of the airplane, and such cther data as are necessary to permit by comparison the determination of the airworthiness of subsequent airplanes of the same type.
